title: Submitting Articles for Website Publication
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder January 8, 2018

The Guild of Harwich Artists invites its members to submit photos, events, and articles to be considered for publication on The Guild of Harwich Artists website. We love to promote our member’s exhibits, their involvement in our community, highlight GHA events, and showcase our talented monthly guest artist demonstrators.

By submitting content, you agree to the following terms:

1. Submission of content does not guarantee publication, GHA Executive Board reserves the right to reject submissions that do not reflect the mission of The Guild of Harwich Artists.
2. You grant permission to use the submission freely in whole or in part without compensation. You retain your ownership rights as applicable, and you will be given appropriate credit or acknowledgment.
3. You grant The Guild of Harwich Artists the right to: a) publish on our website and in other digital or online formats including social media sites; and b) edit or abridge submission for accurate usage, spelling, punctuation, grammar, and/ or space/size requirements.
4. You are the author and that the submission does not violate copyright or any other intellectual property rights or other rights of any third party.

    Archived form: submission is not available on this page.
